title: Handling Rejection
summary: Rejection stings but isn't a verdict on your worth — it's usually about fit or timing. Accept it respectfully, allow yourself to feel it, and avoid pursuing someone who said no.
answer_guidance: Keep it light, practical and encouraging. Define slang plainly and give realistic tips; avoid gender stereotypes.
